results.requirement_document: The users table shall enforce unique, non-null email addresses. A new user with a distinct email shall be inserted successfully.

expert_scenario.precondition: The users table contains one user with email alice@example.com.
expert_scenario.behavior_under_test: Insert a second user with email bob@example.com.
expert_scenario.expected_result: The insertion succeeds and both users exist.

extracted_scenarios.precondition: The email address to be inserted is not already present in the users table.
extracted_scenarios.behavior_under_test: Inserting a new user with a non-null email address that is distinct (i.e., not present in the users table)
extracted_scenarios.expected_result: The insertion is successful and the email address is unique in the users table.

results.requirement_document: The accounts table shall store account balances as non-negative integers. Updating an account to a valid balance shall succeed.

expert_scenario.precondition: An account exists with id 1 and balance 100.

extracted_scenarios.precondition: The accounts table contains at least one account
extracted_scenarios.behavior_under_test: Update an account balance to a non-negative integer (e.g., 10)

extracted_scenarios.precondition: The accounts table contains at least one account
extracted_scenarios.behavior_under_test: Update an account balance to a negative integer (e.g., -5)

extracted_scenarios.precondition: The accounts table contains at least one account
extracted_scenarios.behavior_under_test: Update an account balance to a non-integer (e.g., 10.5)
